static_analysis.issue: File-locking issue on Windows due to interrupted Git operation or process holding onto files in the `refine` directory.

steps_to_fix.step: Close all programs using the directory (e.g., VS Code, Git GUI, file explorers, terminal sessions).
Delete the `refine` directory manually from `C:\Users\bhavi\OneDrive\Desktop\projects\ai agents learnings\Code_Reviewer\src\mastra\public\workspace\`.
If file is in use, end the process using Task Manager or restart the computer.
Retry the cloning process using `git clone https://github.com/refinedev/refine.git`.
Use `rmdir /s /q` in Command Prompt (Admin) to force delete the directory if needed.
Check for antivirus/firewall interference and temporarily disable them.
Use Process Explorer to identify and end processes locking the directory.
Clone the repository to a different directory if the issue persists.

static_analysis.additional_notes: If the issue continues, consider using Git Bash for better file lock handling.

structure_analysis.goal: Understand high-level organization of the codebase.

Are there clear layers (e.g., frontend/backend, API/data, business logic)?
